jobs.tierReason: approval gate before spending money, saved-plan loading
jobs.prompt: Safety review of Phase 11 (plan preview and approval). Files: tools/plan-preview.mjs, tools/plan-commands.mjs, docs/plans/phase11-design.md (the rules), and coordination/review/phase11.diff (swarm.mjs and goal.mjs changes). Check with evidence: (1) can anything run a goal, start a lead or spend money without the owner approving it: no terminal and no --yes, --yes without --max-usd, a declined or empty answer, EOF on stdin, shorthand `swarm "goal"`, `go --plan`, manifest/run-id arguments to go; (2) saved plans: path traversal through the plan id, symlinked .swarm/plans, a plan edited after preview (hash covers manifest only: are flags or goal editable and used?), stale-HEAD check bypass, plan replay (running the same plan twice); (3) does go --plan really run exactly the previewed manifest (budget, caps) and can saved flags override the owner CLI caps in a dangerous direction; (4) calibration: can a bad actual (NaN, huge, negative, attacker text) poison estimates or crash; (5) terminal output: control characters or escape sequences from goal text or folder names reaching the terminal. Report findings ranked high/medium/low with file and line.
